# Copilot Instructions

- This is a Next.js App Router landing page for FlowR, a browser extension for guided workflow recording and replay.
- Keep changes focused on the landing page, SEO, accessibility, and responsive UI quality.
- Use TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, and reusable React components under `components/`.
- Preserve FlowR CTAs: Chrome Web Store, Firefox Add-ons, and Safari as coming soon unless product availability changes.
- Update launch-domain metadata in `app/layout.tsx`, `app/robots.ts`, `app/sitemap.ts`, and structured data in `app/page.tsx` when the final domain is known.
